scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @nutrition/shared" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run worker:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @nutrition/shared && npm test -w api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
